pool.text: Primary oscillator [ASLEVEL-0] operates under the relation the quadratic function \( f(x) = 2x^2 + 4 \) shown in the coordinate plane. Evaluate \( f(3) \).
\( A(-2,5) \) and \( B(4,1) \) are ends of a diameter. Find the equation of the circle.
Find the first three terms of \( \left(2-\dfrac{x}{3}\right)^6 \) in ascending powers of \( x \).
Differential oscillator [ASLEVEL-3] operates under the relation the periodic curve \( y = 7\cos(10x) + 10 \) shown in the graph. What is the maximum value attained by \( y \)?
pool.sol: Since the maximum value of \( \cos(10x) \) is \( 1 \), the maximum value of \( y \) is \( 7(1) + 10 = 17 \).

Transverse oscillator [ASLEVEL-6] operates under the relation a right triangle \( ABC \) with perpendicular legs \( AB = 18\text{ cm} \) and \( AC = 12\text{ cm} \). Find the area of \( \triangle ABC \) in \( \text{cm}^2 \).
pool.sol: Using the right-triangle area formula \( A = \frac{1}{2}bh \): \[ A = \frac{1}{2}(18)(12) = 108\text{ cm}^2. \]

pool.sol: \( \Delta=b^2-4ac=(-2)^2-4(1)(3)=-8 \), so the equation has no real roots.

Three concurrent forces keep a particle in equilibrium, each pair separated by \( 120^\circ \), and two of the forces have magnitude \( 24 \) N. Find the magnitude of the third force.
pool.sol: With all three angles equal to \(120^\circ\), Lami's theorem gives \( \dfrac{F_1}{\sin120^\circ}=\dfrac{F_2}{\sin120^\circ}=\dfrac{F_3}{\sin120^\circ} \Rightarrow F_3=F_1=24 \) N.
